<Heading

  children={"Get all message summaries for a domain"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v2/domains/{domain}/inboxes"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns message summaries for the supplied domain. Use the optional query parameters to scope results to an inbox, control pagination, or request full message payloads. Per the documentation, omitting the inbox filter or setting it to `*` returns messages across the domain.
